abilities.name: Emperor's Judgement
abilities.text: When using a ranged weapon and aiming, a 6 on the Wrath die on a successful attack either inflicts a further 1d3 Mortal Wounds, or allows you to make a free Movement action once the attack is finished.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you ignore any impurities in your Chapter Gene-Seed, and also gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Grim Resolve
abilities.text: You may reroll Double Rank dice once per ranged attack Test when you Aim (p.189).

abilities.name: The Unforgiven (Tradition)
abilities.text: You suffer a +2 DN penalty to any social Tests made against anyone outside of your Chapter. This is a Tradition, not Gene-seed, so it applies, including with his kill-team brothers.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Cunning (+1 Determination); Accomplishment Cleanse and Purge (+1 Max Shock); Goal Advancement (+1 Influence). Determination is 6 (T 5 + 1).

talents.name: Trademark Weapon (Bolt Sniper Rifle)
talents.text: Whenever you make a successful attack with your Trademark Weapon, you deal +Double Rank additional ED. If you lose or destroy your Trademark Weapon, you can no longer receive any benefits from this Talent.

gear: Camo Cloak (Cameleoline Cloak, Core p.237): +1 bonus die to Stealth (A) Tests and +1 to Defence when in shadow or cover
Ammo: 1 Kraken Bolt (AP −2, Core p.231; BOLT weapons only)
